entities.name: Mat'Selesnya
entities.description: Parun of the Selesnya Conclave and worldsoul of Ravnica, an elemental formed from a dozen merged dryads.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: Plane whose life force Mat'Selesnya embodies.

entities.name: Vitu-Ghazi
entities.description: Vast ancient tree at the heart of the Selesnya domain, within which Mat'Selesnya lives.

entities.name: Trostani
entities.description: Chosen agent through whom Mat'Selesnya speaks.

entities.name: Szadek
entities.description: Tried to destroy Mat'Selesnya during the Decamillennial.

entities.name: Guildpact
entities.description: Laws binding the guilds of Ravnica; Mat'Selesnya is its heart.

entities.name: Signing of the Guildpact
entities.description: Event in which Mat'Selesnya took part.

entities.name: Decamillennial
entities.description: Event during which Szadek tried to destroy Mat'Selesnya.

events.summary: Twelve ancient dryads merge into Mat'Selesnya, sacrificing their identities for lasting peace.
events.quote: who had sacrificed their identities and their freedom ten thousand years ago
